gloss: something to look forward to; a treat; a surprise

definitions.gloss: something to look forward to; a treat; a pleasant surprise
definitions.explanation: A pleasure that is coming, or something kept secret until later so that it will be a pleasant surprise. The polite or friendly form of the noun for 'enjoyment'.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{楽|たの}しみ。
examples.english: That's a surprise until the day itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: The summer holiday trip is what I'm looking forward to most.

examples.japanese: ⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{楽|たの}しみにしておいて⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Keep what's in the present as a surprise until you open it.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{楽|たの}しみ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: Look forward to it! (said when announcing something, as at the end of a TV episode: ⟦{次回|じかい}→次回：13170_jikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{楽|たの}しみ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧)
- ～⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{楽|たの}しみ: ~ is a surprise for later
- お{楽|たの}しみにしておく: to save something as a surprise
- ⟦{老後|ろうご}→老後：15131_rougo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{楽|たの}しみ: a pleasure for one's retirement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧: pleasure, something to look forward to; the plain noun, used freely of one's own plans (⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ). お{楽|たの}しみ is the friendly or polite form, typical when speaking to an audience or teasing about a surprise
